description: [Trackly Apply · protocol step] Called by the Trackly Apply skill during a run, using IDs from earlier steps, not as a standalone action. Records a Trackly Apply run receipt for the Trackly Apply skill (review_ready, submitted, failed or blocked). A submitted receipt also records the job on the Tracker; later outcomes such as interview or offer go to trackly_update_tracker_stage. Record review readiness or a user-confirmed outcome. Before handoff use literal outcome=review_ready and verify awaiting_manual_submit. Mark submitted with literal outcome=submitted only after a success page or explicit user confirmation.
